video_slots.brief_title: Plan what to do if growth fails
video_slots.coverage_to_check: Set budgets and stop conditions. Explore narrowing, pivoting, pausing, succession, selling, or closing; identify commitments involving customers, staff, suppliers, and owners.
video_slots.seed_query: pivot pause succession exit strategy startup small business

topics.preferred_demonstration: Compare a waitlist, a price increase, and an additional hire using the same demand and cash assumptions.
topics.learner_assignment: Write a scale, hold, or change memo. Model the cash and capacity effect of one move; name a reversible first step and a stop condition.
topics.assignment_check: The decision follows from demand, margin, cash, and capacity evidence. You know which result would reverse it.

topics.title: Present your plan for the next 90 days
topics.learning_outcome: Defend a business decision and turn it into a specific operating plan.

video_slots.coverage_to_check: Present the customer, the problem, the offer, what happened in tests, how money moves, and the risks. Label assumptions and missing evidence.
video_slots.seed_query: five minute founder pitch evidence risks startup example

video_slots.coverage_to_check: Set one outcome, three milestones, a budget, owners, weekly measures, and triggers to change direction. Match commitments to cash and available time.
video_slots.seed_query: 90 day operating plan business milestones budget ownership example

video_slots.brief_title: Rehearse a review and make the call
video_slots.coverage_to_check: Practice answering skeptical questions about demand, delivery, cash, and obligations. Use the rubric to decide whether to proceed, revise, or pause.
video_slots.seed_query: startup plan review tough founder questions cash demand

topics.preferred_demonstration: Deliver a five-minute capstone pitch and respond to two skeptical questions. Revise one milestone when challenged.
topics.learner_assignment: Submit the portfolio and 90-day plan specified in the capstone. Present to a peer, adviser, or camera and revise after feedback.
topics.assignment_check: An outsider can trace each main claim to evidence, identify unresolved risks, and tell what you will do next week.
